_note: Default model ids and list prices checked 2026-10-20. Override any model with GS_MODEL_<PROVIDER>_<KIND> (e.g. GS_MODEL_GEMINI_IMAGE). Fields: usd = price per unit for the default model and default tier; tiers = per size or quality price for the default model; models = prices of other known model ids (number or tier map); image_usd, texture_usd, rig_usd, ref_usd = surcharges. verified:true means model id and price both came from a source: verified_via 'docs' = official API documentation fetched on 2026-10-20, 'research-notes' = a figure the Oct 2026 research notes cite from an official page (not re-fetched). verified:false means an estimate (see note). source = page confirming the price, docs = page confirming the request shape.

gemini.image.note: Interactions API. gemini-2.5-flash-image is legacy and was shut down on 2026-10-02 per the research notes. Interim 'thought' images are not charged.

gemini.image_edit.note: Same model and price as generation; input images are billed as input tokens (small, not estimated).

gemini.music.note: lyria-3.5 makes songs of about two minutes (length is steered by the prompt only); lyria-3-clip-preview always makes 30 s. No free tier.

gemini.tts.note: Derived: $9.00 per 1M audio output tokens through 2026-12-31 (about 25 tokens per second of speech) plus $0.50 per 1M input tokens, at an assumed 14 characters per second. From 2027-01-01 the token rates double, so the figure becomes about 0.032.

openai.image.note: Token-billed (image output $30 per 1M tokens for GPT Image 2 and 2.5). Per-image figures are the approximate 1024x1024 output costs reported by a third-party calculator write-up for gpt-image-2; 2.5 uses the same token rates. Wide or tall sizes are estimated at 1.5x. The gateway always sends quality explicitly (default medium) so the estimate holds.

openai.image_edit.note: Sunburst is the 2.5 variant recommended for edit precision. ref_usd approximates input-image tokens ($8 per 1M) per source or reference image.

recraft.image.note: 1 API unit = $0.001. Default raster output is WebP, so the gateway requests image_format png.

recraft.image_vector.note: Vector is selected by a *_vector model id and returns SVG; size must be a w:h ratio.

fal.image.note: Model id, input and output schema confirmed on the model page (not deprecated, commercial use). The page does not show a price: $0.003 per megapixel is from memory. The queue REST paths were not re-fetched (the page shows only the JS client).

stability.image.note: Endpoint POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/core and Accept: image/* confirmed; 1 credit = $0.01 per the pricing index. The 3-credit price of Core is from memory.

stability.audio.note: Flat 8 credits per successful generation (1 credit = $0.01); failed generations are not charged. Asynchronous: POST returns 202 {id}, then GET /v2beta/audio/results/{id}.

tripo.model3d.note: Credits per the research notes (P1 page): text 30, image 40, standard texture +10, rig 25, rig-check free. USD per credit is the launch-era $0.01 and may be outdated, so the price is unverified. Model id and the v3 request shape are confirmed by the migration guide and quick start. P2-20260801 (native quad, preview) exists; set GS_MODEL_TRIPO_MODEL3D to use it and re-check credits.

meshy.model3d.note: Credits per the research notes (official pricing page): text preview 20, refine 10, image-to-3D 20 mesh-only or 30 textured. Meshy publishes no USD price for API credits: 0.02 per credit assumed (Pro plan is about 0.019 EUR per credit), so the price is unverified. Model ids (meshy-7.1, meshy-6, latest) confirmed on the text-to-3d page.

elevenlabs.music.note: Indie Game rights only below $500k per game and $1M per year developer revenue; see licence_check.

elevenlabs.sfx.note: loop is only supported by eleven_text_to_sound_v2.

elevenlabs.dialogue.note: Priced as eleven_v3 text to speech; a dialogue-specific rate is not stated in the sources.
